Taste & flavour.text: as others reviewers have mentioned, these really stink.
i have a cocker spaniel who loves treat and though that this nugget help me with his oral care but he spitted it every time i tried, probably does not like the flavor.
i thought the wet food version would be okay, but it made me completely ill.

Ingredients & nutrition.text: the latest is marked "gluten free" and has virtually no heat and little taste.
as a vet tech with tens years experience it is my opinion that this is the worst dog food on the market.

my vet told me not to use this food anymore because it is made in china and the glucosamine in the happy hips formula provides no benefit to my dog because the amount of glucosamine is too small and its not a high quality.

Price & value.text: these were kind of expensive for a dog treat and two of my dogs wouldn't even touch them, so i doubt i would buy them again.
for $9.95, i really don't feel this is a good value at all. disappointed.
i don't feel that i got my money's worth, because they would break up & be gone in 10 minutes, rather than giving hours of enjoyment.

Packaging & portioning.text: i might find a way to cover the food wells with something else, now that i'm stuck with this toy.
it is definatly something you would not want to let your dog use unattended b/c of it being all plastic.
i'm not sure if there are certain kinds of treats that would work better in here, but it does not work as well as i thought it would.

Taste & flavour.text: i made cookies with it this weekend and couldn't stand the taste of the batter or the cookie (i was hoping cooking would get rid of the bad taste).
basicly looks like bread, has the texture of bread - but it is really difficult to get past the fact that it tastes terrible.
i tried another brand and all i tasted was flour and shortening, no peanut flavor at all.
i've tried this a couple of time and both times the noodle just fell apart.
surprisingly lacking in much flavor, just way too sweet, not rich chocolate tasting and far from satisfying for the 110 calorie three little airy bites.
i made a cake with this and it was awful, i used 1 cup in the recipe for the whole cake, which i have done before with splenda.

Condition & expectations.text: not just broken but each cane was in several pieces.
i tested it and in 2 hrs,the gum starts to get really hard to chew,plus the taste is gone..
once a great traditional candy they're now just gross.

Ingredients & nutrition.text: i bought this for my diabetic uncle as a present, and it ended up having tons of sugar. ridiculous.
chocolate is too sweet and no flavor. too bad!
chocolate is too sweet and no flavor. too bad!

Packaging & portioning.text: as shown in the product images,this box contains a very small amount of candy for the price you pay.
the large dog chews have always had different thicknesses, but this bag was all just above paper thin.
lots of things these days have completely unrealistic serving sizes.

Taste & flavour.text: i did not like the taste of this hot chocolate and my kids didn't either.
unfortunately, these were pretty gross - miserable texture and more cardboard flavored than berry.
i do not recommend it for white hot chocolate because it does not taste anything like you would hope.
i know organic has a different taste, but this is bad.

it taste like tree bark ...their is no coffee oil left in this crap..............just buy folgers before you buy this blue mountain crap coffee..i wish i could get my $$$$$ back don't even buy>>>>>>>>>>>>> -1 vote
i highly recommend passing on this stuff--super saccharine taste plus the additional "benefit" of that awful artificial sweetener after taste.

Condition & expectations.text: this coffee is way too coarse to use.
the end result is that the lid easily falls off. further, the quality of the ceramic glaze is terrible.
the odor is terrible and it tastes like the coffee is flat or stale.

Ingredients & nutrition.text: unfortunately, artificial flavoring also plainly occupies the front face. the aroma from the coffee is quite pleasant, however, after brewing, the coffee itself is nothing to write home about.
the express / lattes that were made using these beans was really awful.
the decaf chocolate hazelnut tea has absolutely no flavor even when i try 3 tea bags to a cup of boiling water.

Price & value.text: absolute rip off - i was not sent the item as stated and pictured.
the pricing on this coffee has been getting more and more ridiculous over the last two years.
the only reason i am not more dissatified with this lousy coffee is that i paid very little for it by using a credit i had at amazon payments.

Taste & flavour.text: the taste is ok but i just can't see myself buying this again.i have been a big taco bell fan for years, however this spicy ranchero sauce does nothing for me.
may have been due to the weather but even after adding powdered sugar we still could not use it.
this has the same consistency as natural peanut butter, however, i found this very hard to swallow.

Ingredients & nutrition.text: compared to other stevia extracts, i found this to be a very mediocre product.
i keep trying to like these "natural" sweeteners, but they always come up short in the flavor category.
what is the point of using xylitol if you are going to put nasty toxic crap like artificial colors in here??!! very annoying!

Price & value.text: don't know why this stuff is so horrendously expensive in the grocery stores, for a fraction of the amount you receive from this company.
overall, not a good value, but tasty for packaged.
$25 for 12 cans is not a good deal and if you contact the company directly to find out who sells it near you your bound to get it cheaper than this...

Ingredients & nutrition.text: the change in ingredient profile to include syrup solids is disappointing.
bought the bottles less than a month ago. totally tasteless...odorless...useless.
now why would the description say it's a great alternative to milk when it contains milk by products!?! annoying!

Taste & flavour.text: it may do everything the company claims this product will do, but i just couldn't get past the flavor.
maybe if you like diet soda you will like this, but the 3 people that sampled it did not.
this product tastes terrible and it also tastes nothing like actual coconut water.

Ingredients & nutrition.text: we have tried wetting the food mixing tuna fish water drained from the canned tuna. just something about the content that gives the food an smell lexie doesn't care for. our dog is thirteen years old and is spoil to one type of dry dog food. we can not recommend this product.
however, i was very disappointed the product is tastless.
the "vegetable" contains nothing but desiccated potatoes - no other vegetables!

Condition & expectations.text: they also just threw them in the box,bad packaging.
it was wrapped poorly - the tab you're supposed to pull tore off.
the bottle is pretty and coll looking but the smell and taste is terrible.

Price & value.text: this particular offering, and many others for that matter, do not reflect that value.

i mean, unless your child really, really needs portable applesauce, i'd say stick w/a jar or cups for sooooo much less money, i don't really think this is the best product, and yet another thing to throw in a landfill! not recommended!

Taste & flavour.text: i was so disappointed in this product...it had a horrible aftertaste...no matter how little i used - the taste linger in your mouth for hours...very bad taste...not recommended at all.
i'm not sure what i was expecting but the taste isnt something that makes me want to take another one an the effect of the product isnt anything i felt.
do not purchase this crap as it will arrive rancid and the cans are dented.

Taste & flavour.text: this jerkey is possibly the worst i have ever eaten....the texture is very thready and dry...i tried giving some to my dog and he wouldn't even eat it!
i guess this is a personal opinion, but i don't particulary like the taste of this.
disappointingly, this is imitation almond extract and a terrible value.

Condition & expectations.text: i am thinking about getting away from this product due to inconsistency with amazon delivery and freshness. i would say: buyer beware
these are really dry and really can't be eaten unless you soak them first.

Ingredients & nutrition.text: i read this description over and over, and still it didn't make any sense. ten bars!
so far nothing with malitol tastes "right" to me.
it's very, very fatty, greasy to the touch and too bland.

Taste & flavour.text: i expected it to have it's usual fresh, potent citrus flavor and instead it's mostly bland.
i did not like these beans and won't be purchasing them again.
unfortunately the batch of sumac i received had very little flavor to it at all.

Ingredients & nutrition.text: i hope this is just a bad batch because nobody else in the reviews complained about this being too salty to eat.
i don't recommend this unless you really really like salt.
a lot of the other triscuit brands like garlic tastes terrible and has hidden msg.

Taste & flavour.text: i think with all the oil that leached out, it upset the flavor balance of the chip and now they just taste really salty and stale. tried 3 different bags, and it was the same in each case (couldnt eat more than a couple of chips, they were that bad).
these do not taste the same as before, i do not know if they have changed something - but these are disappointing to say the least.
i had high hopes for this mix but ended up being not too happy with it.

Condition & expectations.text: not good, product was old and nearly passed due, poor quality and taste when compared to a fresh product.
too many products labelled as spicy are not, have no kick, and are as bland as can be.
the product seemed dry and the taste was inconsistent with previously purchased, fresher products.

Ingredients & nutrition.text: considering the soy is at the end of the ingredient list after various oils and before the salt, then such soy is just a marketing gimmick to help excuse such a disappointing blue corn chip.
stay away from this product if you want to control your calorie intake, by taking supposedly healthier dried vegetable chips.
be warned that these chips have no salt.

Packaging & portioning.text: after opening the box it looking like it fell down a set of stairs.
it was supposed to be a six pack of bars but only five were in the ziplock bag they came in.

i wanted to try the squeeze packs because the other brand i have eaten in the past though good, it's such a pain to have to stir this huge jar of it every time and i like to keep an eye on my calories so having to measure out a serving from a jar each time gets messy plus it's so bland i always add a little honey to it.

Taste & flavour.text: i know kellogg's is really pushing the "special k" diet and all, but this is the worst tasting cereal i've ever had.
i was very disappointed in the taste of this product.
i opened 4 of the 12 cans in this case and in each of them, less than 10 beans per can were edible.

Ingredients & nutrition.text: if people want to feed sugar to their kids they can add separately, i just don't understand why they add sugar to this baby food.

plus, most of them were just full of sugar anyway.

Packaging & portioning.text: though the idea was still cute, each cup had very smudged artwork and the cups all had black ash on the outside of them while sealed in the general mills box.
you might as well eat the box it came in.

Taste & flavour.text: it is lovely to smell, disappointing to drink - very little citrus tones (as in, none i could detect) with just the slightest tang of bergamot oil. extremely disappointing.

they're just not all that tasty, and all have a nasty aftertaste from the artificial sweeteners. this product almost earned itself a one-star review because in addition to the aftertaste, there are little crumbly bits in it that just aren't a pleasant thing to encounter in a beverage.
one major problem, this "tea" has zero tea flavor.

Ingredients & nutrition.text: tea tastes good but it doesn't do anything.
it's hard to find a powder that tastes good and is decaf. i find these types of products very artifical tasting and i really don't enjoy them.
the tea is slightly bitter, not very flavorful, nor memorable.

Packaging & portioning.text: the bag that is holding the tea leaves is impossible to use.
on the box it tells you not to drink more than 1 cup in a 24 hour period- i drank three the other day not even thinking about it and nothing happened!
